### OCS Inventory NG

**Categories:** Policy, governance and compliance<br>
**Roles:** DevSecOps Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer, Platform Engineer<br>
**Model:** Open Core<br>
**Status:** Active

IT inventory platform that collects hardware and software data from agents and network discovery.

**Use when**

- You need automated endpoint and network asset inventory with self-hosted data control.

**Consider alternatives when**

- Avoid it when agentless cloud inventory or a full IT service-management workflow is the primary requirement.

[Official site](https://ocsinventory-ng.org/) · [Documentation](https://wiki.ocsinventory-ng.org/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/OCSInventory-NG/OCSInventory-Server)

### Prowler

**Categories:** Application and cloud security, Policy, governance and compliance<br>
**Roles:** Cloud Security Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer<br>
**Model:** Open Core<br>
**Status:** Active

Cloud security posture and compliance assessment platform for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Kubernetes.

**Use when**

- You need repeatable cloud configuration checks and compliance evidence across supported providers.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You need real-time workload protection or a provider-neutral control framework not covered by its checks.

### Risk Analysis Editor

**Categories:** Policy, governance and compliance<br>
**Roles:** Cloud Security Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Offline browser-based editor for configurable risk registers, treatment plans, matrices, and reports.

**Use when**

- You need an offline, file-based risk-analysis workflow using EBIOS RM, GDPR DPIA, ISO 27005, or a custom scoring model.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You require collaborative workflow, centralized approvals, or integrations supplied by a governance platform.

[Official site](https://www.risk-analysis-editor.com/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/StephaneV/Risk-Analysis-Editor)
